prompt: Create an original 60 second orchestral adventure instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: strings, French horn, timpani, flute. Style: rising motifs, dynamic arcs and clear melodic development. Tempo approximately 96 BPM; D major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An elegant and dramatic classical orchestral piece featuring prominent strings, piano, and woodwinds, building from a melancholic opening to a more intense, cinematic feel.
description.zh: 一首优雅而富有戏剧性的古典管弦乐曲，以突出的弦乐、钢琴和木管乐器为主，从忧郁的开场逐渐发展为更强烈、电影般的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
